specs.title: Order with a card, from basket to order history

steps.title: Precondition: log in the customer with an empty basket
1. Add product A two times and product B one time from the product list
2. Open the basket
3. Click Checkout, select the saved address and click Continue
4. Select One Day Delivery and click Continue
5. Redeem the coupon of the current month
6. Select the saved card and click Continue
7. Click Place your order and pay
8. Read the order summary on the confirmation page
9. Read the basket counter and open the empty basket
10. Open the order history
